knitr runs each chunk with the working directory set to the .Rmd's own location.
`config.R` has to come between the other two -- it defines `data.root`,

and which every path in this notebook is built from.

# Panels C, I: donor-acceptor splice maps

In vitro donor->acceptor splice maps
Prerequisite: bamsort_splice; for Ca*Re, `submissionScripts/Figure1/` stepTwo,
which writes the per-group splice tables.

```{r}
care.splice.dir <- function(group) {
  paste0(data.root, "Figure1/CaRe/", group, "/bamsort/splice/")
}

suppfig3.dir <- paste0(plot.root, "Supplemental/SuppFig3/")
dir.create(suppfig3.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

sample_configs <- list(
  list(
    name = "Invitro_CaRe",
    panel = "PanelI",
    files = c("Invitro_D1_PL", "Invitro_env_PL", "Invitro_pol_PL", "Invitro_SSenv_PL",
              "Invitro_tat"),
    input_dir = care.splice.dir("invitro"),
    umi_type = "CaRe",
    umi_group = "invitro",
    umi_sample_name = "Invitro"
  ),
  list(
    name = "Invitro_GEX",
    panel = "PanelC",
    files = c("invitro"),
    input_dir = paste0(data.root, "Figure1/singleCell/bamsort/splice/"),
    umi_type = "TenX",
    umi_sample_name = "Invitro"
  ),
  list(
    name = "D195_CaRe",
    out_dir = suppfig3.dir,
    files = c("D195_D1_PL", "D195_env_PL", "D195_pol_PL", "D195_SSenv_PL",
              "D195_tat"),
    input_dir = care.splice.dir("ART"),
    umi_type = "CaRe",
    umi_group = "ART",
    umi_sample_name = "D195"
  ),
  list(
    name = "D195_GEX",
    out_dir = suppfig3.dir,
    files = c("D195"),
    input_dir = paste0(data.root, "Figure1/singleCell/bamsort/splice/"),
    umi_type = "TenX",
    umi_sample_name = "D195"
  )
)

care.reads.dir <- function(group) {
  paste0(data.root, "Figure1/CaRe/", group, "/bamsort/reads/")
}

donor_ref    <- c(D1 = 431, D2 = 4730, D3 = 5217, D4 = 6043)
acceptor_ref <- c(A1 = 4658, A2 = 5141, A3 = 5746, A4 = 5818, A5 = 5959, A7 = 8249)

# Endpoints within JUNCTION_TOLERANCE bp are collapsed
JUNCTION_TOLERANCE <- 10

# Clusters are seeded from the best-supported position. A cluster landing within
# tol of a canonical site takes that site's coordinate.
snap_sites <- function(positions, weights, reference, tol) {
  support <- tapply(weights, positions, sum)
  pos     <- as.numeric(names(support))
  sup     <- as.numeric(support)
  rep_of  <- rep(NA_real_, length(pos))

  for (i in order(sup, decreasing = TRUE)) {
    if (!is.na(rep_of[i])) next
    center <- pos[i]
    near   <- reference[abs(reference - center) <= tol]
    representative <- if (length(near) > 0) near[which.min(abs(near - center))] else center
    rep_of[is.na(rep_of) & abs(pos - center) <= tol] <- representative
  }
  rep_of[match(positions, pos)]
}
TenX.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure1/singleCell/bamsort/reads/")
output.dir <- paste0(plot.root, "Figure2/")
dir.create(output.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


map_quant <- data.frame()

for (config in sample_configs) {
  sample_name <- config$name
  input_dir <- config$input_dir

  cat("\nProcessing sample:", sample_name, "\n")

  # Step 1: Combine data from all files in this sample
  combined_data <- data.frame()
  sample_molecules <- data.frame()

  for (file in config$files) {
    candidates <- paste0(input_dir, file, "_splicesites.csv")
    csv_path <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)][1]
    if (is.na(csv_path)) {
      cat("    WARNING: no splicesites CSV found for", file, "- skipping\n")
      next
    }
    data <- read.csv(csv_path)

    if (nrow(data) == 0) {
      cat("    no spliced reads in", file, "- skipping\n")
      next
    }

    if (config$umi_type == "CaRe") {
      umi_file <- paste0(care.reads.dir(config$umi_group), "minimum/valid_UMI/",
                         config$umi_sample_name, "_valid_cellID_UMI.csv")
      umi_data <- if(file.exists(umi_file)) read.csv(umi_file) else NULL
    } else if (config$umi_type == "TenX") {
      umi_file <- paste0(TenX.dir, "minimum/valid_UMI/", config$umi_sample_name, "_GEX_valid_cellID_UMI.csv")
      umi_data <- if(file.exists(umi_file)) read.csv(umi_file) else NULL
    } else {
      stop("Invalid umi_type: must be 'CaRe' or 'TenX'")
    }

    # Rows are deduplicated molecules
    if (is.null(umi_data)) {
      cat("    WARNING: UMI file not found, skipping filtering\n")
      kept <- data
    } else {
      # Match on the (cellID, UMI) pair
      kept <- data %>%
        mutate(CB = as.character(CB)) %>%
        semi_join(umi_data %>%
                    mutate(cellID = as.character(cellID)) %>%
                    select(cellID, UMI),
                  by = c("CB" = "cellID", "UB" = "UMI"))
    }

    file_data <- kept %>%
      count(Donor, Acceptor) %>%
      mutate(file = file)

    combined_data <- rbind(combined_data, file_data)
    sample_molecules <- rbind(sample_molecules,
                              kept %>% distinct(CB, UB))
  }

  if (nrow(combined_data) == 0) {
    cat("  No splice data for this sample - skipping\n")
    next
  }

  # Step 2: collapse endpoints within JUNCTION_TOLERANCE, then sum counts across
  # files
  n_exact <- nrow(distinct(combined_data, Donor, Acceptor))
  combined_data <- combined_data %>%
    mutate(
      Donor    = snap_sites(Donor,    n, donor_ref,    JUNCTION_TOLERANCE),
      Acceptor = snap_sites(Acceptor, n, acceptor_ref, JUNCTION_TOLERANCE)
    )

  plotdata <- combined_data %>%
    group_by(Donor, Acceptor) %>%
    summarise(
      raw_count = sum(n),
      files = paste(unique(file), collapse = ", "),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    arrange(Donor) %>%
    mutate(
      y_position = row_number(),
      log_count = log1p(raw_count)
    )

  # events counts a molecule once per distinct junction it carries
  n_molecules <- nrow(distinct(sample_molecules, CB, UB))
  cat("  Combined junctions:", nrow(plotdata),
      sprintf("(from %d exact coordinate pairs, tolerance %dbp)\n",
              n_exact, JUNCTION_TOLERANCE))
  cat("  Splice counts:", n_molecules, "\n")

  map_quant <- rbind(map_quant, data.frame(
    sample    = config$umi_sample_name,
    method    = ifelse(config$umi_type == "CaRe", "Ca*Re", "TenX"),
    junctions = nrow(plotdata),
    events    = sum(plotdata$raw_count),
    molecules = n_molecules
  ))

  # Splicing rate vs deduplicated TenX reads mapping to mac239 in Invitro
  if (sample_name == "Invitro_CaRe" && exists("tenx_data") && !is.null(tenx_data)) {
    invitro_tenx_mac239_total <- sum(tenx_data$total, na.rm = TRUE)
    cat(sprintf("  Splicing events after QC: %d / %d deduplicated Invitro TenX mac239 reads (%.4f%%)\n",
                nrow(plotdata), invitro_tenx_mac239_total,
                100 * nrow(plotdata) / invitro_tenx_mac239_total))
  }

  if (nrow(plotdata) > 0) {
  # Share color scale
  MAX_LOG <- 9

  plotdata <- plotdata %>%
    arrange(Donor, Acceptor) %>%
    mutate(y_position = row_number())
  n_junctions <- nrow(plotdata)

  RIBBON_HEIGHT <- 0.8
  make_splice_map <- function(fill_var, fill_scale) {
    ggplot(plotdata) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = donor_ref,    color = "blue", linewidth = 0.4) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = acceptor_ref, color = "red",  linewidth = 0.4) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 1.5) +
      geom_rect(aes(xmin = Donor, xmax = Acceptor,
                    ymin = y_position - RIBBON_HEIGHT / 2,
                    ymax = y_position + RIBBON_HEIGHT / 2,
                    fill = .data[[fill_var]])) +
      annotate("text", x = donor_ref,    y = -0.4, vjust = 1,
               label = names(donor_ref),    color = "blue", size = 3) +
      annotate("text", x = acceptor_ref, y = n_junctions + 0.8, vjust = 0,
               label = names(acceptor_ref), color = "red",  size = 3) +
      fill_scale +
      scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 10279)) +
      scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.1))) +
      labs(title = paste0("Splice Junctions: ", sample_name),
           x = "Genomic Position", y = NULL) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
            panel.grid = element_blank(),
            legend.position = "right")
  }

  panel_prefix <- if (!is.null(config$panel)) paste0(config$panel, "_") else ""
  config_out <- if (!is.null(config$out_dir)) config$out_dir else output.dir

  p_log_viridis <- make_splice_map("log_count",
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "log(Count+1)", limits = c(0, MAX_LOG),
                         oob = scales::squish))
  ggsave(paste0(config_out, panel_prefix, sample_name, "_combined_log.pdf"),
         plot = p_log_viridis, width = 15, height = 8)

  # p_linear_viridis <- make_splice_map("raw_count",
  #   scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Count", oob = scales::squish))
  # ggsave(paste0(config_out, panel_prefix, sample_name, "_combined_linear.pdf"),
  #        plot = p_linear_viridis, width = 15, height = 8)

  } else {
    cat("  No junctions found for this sample\n")
  }
}

# Per-map quantification
map_quant <- map_quant %>%
  mutate(
    sample = factor(sample, levels = c("Invitro", "D195")),
    method = factor(method, levels = c("TenX", "Ca*Re"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(sample, method)
cat("\nSplice-map quantification (per sample x method):\n"); print(map_quant)
write.csv(map_quant, paste0(output.dir, "splice_map_quantification.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

# Panel J: splice recovery rate (TenX vs Ca*Re)

Splice recovery in vitro, normalized to each method's own viral molecule count.
Prerequisite: the Panels C, I chunk above.

```{r}
tenx_viral_total  <- sum(read.csv(paste0(TenX.dir,
                                        "minimum/Invitro_GEX_filtered.csv"))$total)
care_viral_total <- sum(read.csv(paste0(care.reads.dir("invitro"),
                                        "minimum/Invitro_CaRe_filtered.csv"))$total)

splice_summary <- map_quant %>%
  filter(sample == "Invitro") %>%
  mutate(
    viral_molecules = ifelse(method == "TenX", tenx_viral_total, care_viral_total),
    rate_per_10k    = 10000 * molecules / viral_molecules
  ) %>%
  arrange(method)
cat("Splice recovery summary (in vitro):\n"); print(splice_summary)

if (nrow(splice_summary) < 2) {
  stop("Panel J needs both the TenX and Ca*Re Invitro rows of map_quant")
}

rate_test <- prop.test(splice_summary$molecules, splice_summary$viral_molecules)
p_rate    <- rate_test$p.value
stars     <- if (p_rate < 0.001) "***" else if (p_rate < 0.01) "**" else
             if (p_rate < 0.05)  "*"   else "ns"
sig_label <- sprintf("%s (p = %s)", stars, format.pval(p_rate, digits = 2))
cat(sprintf("Rate proportion test (TenX vs Ca*Re): chisq = %.1f, p = %s\n",
            rate_test$statistic, format.pval(p_rate, digits = 3)))


y_top <- max(splice_summary$rate_per_10k)
p_recovery_rate <- ggplot(splice_summary,
                          aes(x = method, y = rate_per_10k, fill = method)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", rate_per_10k)), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 2, y = y_top * 1.6, yend = y_top * 1.6) +
  annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 1, y = y_top * 1.6, yend = y_top * 1.35) +
  annotate("segment", x = 2, xend = 2, y = y_top * 1.6, yend = y_top * 1.35) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = y_top * 1.9, label = sig_label, size = 3) +
  scale_y_log10(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TenX" = "#2B3990", "Ca*Re" = "#00AEEF"),
                    guide = "none") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "", y = "Spliced molecules / 10,000 viral molecules (log scale)",
       title = "Splice recovery rate: TenX vs Ca*Re (in vitro)")
ggsave(paste0(output.dir, "PanelJ_splice_recovery_rate.pdf"),
       p_recovery_rate, width = 3.5, height = 4)
print(p_recovery_rate)
```


# Panel D: long-read coverage silhouette

Prerequisites: `samtools` on PATH and the long-read BAM

```{r}
output.dir   <- paste0(plot.root, "Figure2/")
dir.create(output.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

longread_bam <- paste0(data.root, "Figure2/longRead/nf-core/cDNA/bam/dedup/cDNA.dedup.sorted.bam")
viral_contig <- "mac239"   # viral contig name in the Mmul_10+mac239 reference
cov_csv      <- paste0(output.dir, "PanelD_longread_coverage.csv")


if (file.exists(cov_csv)) {
  cov <- read.csv(cov_csv)
} else if (nzchar(Sys.which("samtools")) && file.exists(longread_bam)) {
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".txt")
  status <- system2("samtools",
                    c("depth", "-a", "-r", viral_contig, shQuote(longread_bam)),
                    stdout = tmp)
  cov <- read.table(tmp, sep = "\t", col.names = c("contig", "pos", "depth"))
  unlink(tmp)
  write.csv(cov, cov_csv, row.names = FALSE)
} else {
  cov <- NULL
  message("Panel D coverage skipped: need either the cached CSV, or samtools ",
          "on PATH plus the long-read BAM at\n  ", longread_bam)
}

if (!is.null(cov) && nrow(cov) > 0) {
  coverage_plot <- ggplot(cov, aes(x = pos, y = depth)) +
    geom_area(fill = "gray60", color = NA) +
    scale_y_log10(limits = c(1, NA),
                  breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000),
                  expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(0)) +
    labs(x = "mac239 position (bp)", y = "Coverage") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

  ggsave(paste0(output.dir, "PanelD_longread_coverage.pdf"),
         coverage_plot, width = 12, height = 1.8)
  print(coverage_plot)
}
```

# In-text numbers : long-read

Values quoted in the Results text for the short-read vs long-read comparison.

Prerequisites: `submissionScripts/Figure2/bamsort_isoform_longread.sh`, and the
cellranger `molecule_info.h5` for the in-vitro library at
`Figure1/singleCell/counts/outs_Invitro/`, which the viral saturation is read
from directly.

```{r}
output.dir <- paste0(plot.root, "Figure2/")
dir.create(output.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 10X viral-specific saturation, computed from the molecule_info.h5 per-molecule
# read counts because metrics_summary.csv reports only whole-transcriptome
# saturation.
molecule_info_h5 <- paste0(data.root,
  "Figure1/singleCell/counts/outs_Invitro/molecule_info.h5")
tenx_saturation <- tenx_viral_saturation(molecule_info_h5, viral_feature = "mac239")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(tenx_saturation))) {
  row <- tenx_saturation[i, ]
  cat(sprintf("10X [%s]: viral saturation = 1 - %d UMIs / %d reads = %.2f%%\n",
              row$barcode_set, row$viral_umis, row$viral_reads,
              100 * row$viral_saturation))
  cat(sprintf("   estimated viral library complexity %.0f -> %.1f%% observed\n",
              row$estimated_complexity, 100 * row$fraction_observed))
}

isoform_csv <- paste0(data.root, "Figure2/longRead/bamsort/isoform/cDNA_isoforms.csv")
longread_molecules <- read.csv(isoform_csv)
if (!"ref_start" %in% names(longread_molecules)) {
  stop("`ref_start` column missing from ", isoform_csv, " -- re-run ",
       "submissionScripts/Figure2/bamsort_isoform_longread.sh")
}

# Molecules starting at either targeted amplicon position are reported
# separately from untargeted ones.
AMPLICON_STARTS <- c(amplicon_gag = 1440, amplicon_envprimer = 8797)
AMPLICON_TOLERANCE <- 6

longread_molecules$group <- "untargeted"
for (amplicon in names(AMPLICON_STARTS)) {
  is_amplicon <- abs(longread_molecules$ref_start -
                       AMPLICON_STARTS[[amplicon]]) <= AMPLICON_TOLERANCE
  longread_molecules$group[is_amplicon] <- amplicon
}

for (group in c("untargeted", names(AMPLICON_STARTS))) {
  molecules <- longread_molecules[longread_molecules$group == group, ]
  n_molecules <- nrow(molecules)
  if (n_molecules == 0) next
  n_US <- sum(molecules$isoform == "US")
  n_SS <- sum(molecules$isoform == "SS")
  n_MS <- sum(molecules$isoform == "MS")
  n_resolved <- n_US + n_SS + n_MS
  cat(sprintf("\nlong-read [%s]: %d molecules\n", group, n_molecules))
  cat(sprintf("   resolved to a single isoform: %d/%d = %.1f%%\n",
              n_resolved, n_molecules, 100 * n_resolved / n_molecules))
  if (n_resolved > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("   of resolved, unspliced (US):  %d/%d = %.1f%%\n",
                n_US, n_resolved, 100 * n_US / n_resolved))
    cat(sprintf("   of resolved, spliced (SS+MS): %d/%d = %.1f%%\n",
                n_SS + n_MS, n_resolved, 100 * (n_SS + n_MS) / n_resolved))
  }
  # Junction count per molecule: only a molecule spanning >= 2 junctions carries
  # isoform information a short read spanning one junction could not report.
  cat(sprintf(paste0("   junctions per molecule: 0 = %d (%.1f%%), ",
                     "1 = %d (%.1f%%), >=2 = %d (%.1f%%)\n"),
              sum(molecules$n_junctions == 0),
              100 * mean(molecules$n_junctions == 0),
              sum(molecules$n_junctions == 1),
              100 * mean(molecules$n_junctions == 1),
              sum(molecules$n_junctions >= 2),
              100 * mean(molecules$n_junctions >= 2)))
  cat(sprintf("   aligned viral bases: median %.0f, max %d\n",
              median(molecules$aligned_bases),
              max(molecules$aligned_bases)))
}
```

# Panel G: polyA

Prerequisites: `mac239.fa` and `d400_class_polya_structure_analysis.csv`

## Extraction

```{r}
fasta_path  <- paste0(genome.root, "Mmul_10_mac239/inputs/mac239.fa")
input_csv   <- paste0(data.root, "Figure2/polyA/bam_polya_virus/d400_class_polya_structure_analysis.csv")
results_csv <- paste0(plot.root, "Figure2/polyA_explained.csv")
seurat_umap_csv <- paste0(data.root, "Figure1/singleCell/Seurat/UMAPcoords/D13UMAP_coords.csv")
dir.create(dirname(results_csv), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# SIVmac239 terminal polyA cleavage sites in mac239.fa (length 9602).
# Note the R region (containing the PAS) is duplicated between 5'LTR and 3'LTR
# STAR multi-map handling may place terminal R1 reads at either LTR's R region
terminal_sites <- c(141L, 9602L)
min_lengths <- c(6L, 7L, 8L, 9L, 10L)
max_nonAs   <- c(0L, 1L, 2L)
min_dists_r2 <- c(400L, 500L, 600L)
min_dists_r1 <- c(50L, 100L, 150L)

# Maximal A-rich region detection: walk every A-start, extend while
# mismatches <= max_nonA, keep the furthest A-end of length >= min_length.
find_arich_regions <- function(sequence, min_length, max_nonA) {
  bases <- strsplit(sequence, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  is_a  <- bases == "A"
  n     <- length(bases)
  starts_idx <- which(is_a)
  out <- vector("list", length(starts_idx))
  k <- 0L
  for (i in starts_idx) {
    mismatches <- 0L
    last_valid_end <- NA_integer_
    j <- i
    while (j <= n) {
      if (!is_a[j]) {
        mismatches <- mismatches + 1L
        if (mismatches > max_nonA) break
      }
      if (is_a[j] && (j - i + 1L) >= min_length) {
        last_valid_end <- j
      }
      j <- j + 1L
    }
    if (!is.na(last_valid_end)) {
      mm_count <- sum(!is_a[i:last_valid_end])
      k <- k + 1L
      out[[k]] <- c(i, last_valid_end, last_valid_end - i + 1L, mm_count)
    }
  }
  if (k == 0L) {
    return(data.frame(start_position = integer(), end_position = integer(),
                      length = integer(), mismatches = integer()))
  }
  m <- do.call(rbind, out[seq_len(k)])
  data.frame(start_position = as.integer(m[, 1]),
             end_position   = as.integer(m[, 2]),
             length         = as.integer(m[, 3]),
             mismatches     = as.integer(m[, 4]))
}

# Drop nested intervals (any whose end <= max end already kept).
deduplicate_regions <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0L) return(df)
  df <- df[order(df$start_position, -df$end_position, df$mismatches), ]
  keep <- logical(nrow(df))
  max_end <- -1L
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
    if (df$end_position[k] <= max_end) next
    keep[k] <- TRUE
    max_end <- df$end_position[k]
  }
  df[keep, , drop = FALSE]
}

# Read2 classifier: priming site is DOWNSTREAM of read2_pos. Find closest
# polyA start strictly > r2 and classify by distance
classify_reads_r2 <- function(r2_positions, polyA_starts, min_dist, terminal_sites) {
  all_starts <- sort(unique(c(as.integer(polyA_starts), as.integer(terminal_sites))))
  terminal_set <- as.integer(terminal_sites)
  idx <- findInterval(r2_positions, all_starts) + 1L
  has_downstream <- idx <= length(all_starts)
  closest_start  <- ifelse(has_downstream, all_starts[pmin(idx, length(all_starts))],
                           NA_integer_)
  min_d <- closest_start - r2_positions
  result <- ifelse(!has_downstream | is.na(min_d) | min_d > min_dist,
                   "unexplained",
                   ifelse(closest_start %in% terminal_set, "terminal", "internal"))
  c(terminal    = sum(result == "terminal"),
    internal    = sum(result == "internal"),
    unexplained = sum(result == "unexplained"))
}

# Read1 classifier: priming site is AT read1_end (Read1 aligns reverse on +
# strand viral transcripts; reference_end is the polyT-anchor side). Find the
# closest polyA start in EITHER direction and classify by absolute distance.
classify_reads_r1 <- function(r1_ends, polyA_starts, min_dist, terminal_sites) {
  all_starts <- sort(unique(c(as.integer(polyA_starts), as.integer(terminal_sites))))
  terminal_set <- as.integer(terminal_sites)
  idx_after  <- findInterval(r1_ends, all_starts) + 1L
  idx_before <- pmax(idx_after - 1L, 1L)
  d_after  <- ifelse(idx_after  <= length(all_starts),
                     all_starts[pmin(idx_after, length(all_starts))] - r1_ends,
                     .Machine$integer.max)
  d_before <- r1_ends - all_starts[idx_before]
  use_after <- abs(d_after) < abs(d_before)
  closest_start <- ifelse(use_after,
                          all_starts[pmin(idx_after, length(all_starts))],
                          all_starts[idx_before])
  min_abs <- pmin(abs(d_after), abs(d_before))
  result  <- ifelse(min_abs > min_dist,
                    "unexplained",
                    ifelse(closest_start %in% terminal_set, "terminal", "internal"))
  c(terminal    = sum(result == "terminal"),
    internal    = sum(result == "internal"),
    unexplained = sum(result == "unexplained"))
}

fasta_lines <- readLines(fasta_path, warn = FALSE)
sequence    <- toupper(paste(fasta_lines[!grepl("^>", fasta_lines)], collapse = ""))

reads <- read.csv(input_csv)
if (!"read1_end" %in% names(reads)) {
  stop("`read1_end` column missing from input CSV — re-run bam_polya_virus.py ",
       "(via run_polya.sh) to regenerate the per-read CSV with Read1/Read2 ",
       "reference_end columns.")
}
if (!"cb_corrected" %in% names(reads)) {
  stop("`cb_corrected` column missing from input CSV — re-run ",
       "bam_polya_virus.py with --cellranger-bam to source corrected CB/UB ",
       "tags from the Cell Ranger possorted BAM.")
}

# Filter (a): keep only reads from Seurat-filtered cellIDs
seurat_cellIDs <- read.csv(seurat_umap_csv)$cellID
n_before <- nrow(reads)
reads <- reads %>%
  filter(!is.na(cb_corrected) & cb_corrected %in% seurat_cellIDs)
cat(sprintf("Seurat cellID filter: %d -> %d pairs (%.1f%% kept)\n",
            n_before, nrow(reads), 100 * nrow(reads) / max(n_before, 1)))

# Filter (b): keep only UMIs with > 1 read
n_before <- nrow(reads)
reads <- reads %>%
  group_by(cb_corrected, ub_corrected) %>%
  filter(n() > 1) %>%
  ungroup()
cat(sprintf("UMI read-count > 1 filter: %d -> %d pairs (%.1f%% kept)\n",
            n_before, nrow(reads), 100 * nrow(reads) / max(n_before, 1)))

r2_pos  <- as.integer(reads$read2_pos)
r1_ends <- as.integer(reads$read1_end)

polyA_cache <- list()

# Random-position control
N_RANDOM    <- 20000
RANDOM_SEED <- 0
set.seed(RANDOM_SEED)
random_positions <- sample.int(nchar(sequence), N_RANDOM, replace = TRUE)

# Each entry is one (anchor, end set) pair: the positions to classify, the
# classifier for that anchor, and that anchor's distance grid.
end_sets <- list(
  list(anchor = "Read2", end_set = "reads",  positions = r2_pos,
       classifier = classify_reads_r2, dists = min_dists_r2),
  list(anchor = "Read2", end_set = "random", positions = random_positions,
       classifier = classify_reads_r2, dists = min_dists_r2),
  list(anchor = "Read1", end_set = "reads",  positions = r1_ends,
       classifier = classify_reads_r1, dists = min_dists_r1),
  list(anchor = "Read1", end_set = "random", positions = random_positions,
       classifier = classify_reads_r1, dists = min_dists_r1)
)

results_rows <- list()
for (A in min_lengths) {
  for (M in max_nonAs) {
    key <- paste(A, M, sep = "_")
    if (is.null(polyA_cache[[key]])) {
      polyA_cache[[key]] <- deduplicate_regions(find_arich_regions(sequence, A, M))
    }
    starts <- polyA_cache[[key]]$start_position
    if (length(starts) == 0L) {
      cat(sprintf("Skipping %dA_%dM: no internal polyA tracts in genome\n", A, M))
      next
    }
    for (set in end_sets) {
      for (D in set$dists) {
        counts <- set$classifier(set$positions, starts, D, terminal_sites)
        results_rows[[length(results_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
          anchor             = set$anchor,
          end_set            = set$end_set,
          parameters         = sprintf("%dA_%dM_%dD", A, M, D),
          explained_terminal = counts["terminal"],
          explained_internal = counts["internal"],
          unexplained        = counts["unexplained"],
          row.names          = NULL
        )
      }
    }
  }
}
results_full <- do.call(rbind, results_rows)
write.csv(results_full, results_csv, row.names = FALSE)

# For in-text internal vs terminal value (per anchor)
ratios <- results_full %>%
  filter(end_set == "reads") %>%
  assignable_sets(label = "Virus") %>%
  separate(parameters, c("A_str", "M_str", "D_str"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(A = as.integer(sub("A$", "", A_str)),
         M = as.integer(sub("M$", "", M_str)),
         D = as.integer(sub("D$", "", D_str))) %>%
  mutate(int_to_term = ifelse(explained_terminal == 0,
                              Inf,
                              explained_internal / explained_terminal)) %>%
  arrange(anchor, int_to_term) %>%
  select(anchor, parameters, explained_terminal, explained_internal, int_to_term)


ratios_pd <- ratios %>%
  separate(parameters, c("A_str", "M_str", "D_str"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(A = as.integer(sub("A$", "", A_str)),
         M = as.integer(sub("M$", "", M_str)),
         D = as.integer(sub("D$", "", D_str)))
for (a in unique(ratios_pd$anchor)) {
  sub <- ratios_pd %>% filter(anchor == a)
  most_stringent <- sub %>% arrange(desc(A), M, D) %>% slice(1)
  cat(sprintf("[%s] Most stringent (%s) internal:terminal ratio: %.1fx\n",
              a, most_stringent$parameters, most_stringent$int_to_term))
}
```

```{r}
stack_colors <- c("terminal polyA" = "#006838",
                  "internal polyA" = "#C4D8B6",
                  "unexplained"    = "#3b3b3b")

make_stacked_bar <- function(df, horizontal = FALSE) {
  df_sorted <- df %>% arrange(D, A, M)
  long <- df_sorted %>%
    mutate(parameters = factor(parameters, levels = df_sorted$parameters)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(terminal_pct, internal_pct, unexplained_pct),
                 names_to = "category", values_to = "pct") %>%
    mutate(category = recode(category,
                             terminal_pct    = "terminal polyA",
                             internal_pct    = "internal polyA",
                             unexplained_pct = "unexplained"),
           category = factor(category,
                             levels = c("internal polyA",
                                        "unexplained",
                                        "terminal polyA")))

  if (horizontal) {
    inside_labels <- long %>%
      filter(category != "terminal polyA") %>%
      mutate(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct),
             text_color = ifelse(category == "internal polyA", "black", "white"))
    terminal_labels <- long %>%
      filter(category == "terminal polyA") %>%
      mutate(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct))

    n_params <- length(levels(long$parameters))
    callout_x <- n_params + 1.4
    arrow_x_start <- n_params + 1.0
    arrow_x_end <- n_params + 0.35

    p <- ggplot(long, aes(x = parameters, y = pct, fill = category)) +
      geom_col(alpha = 0.9, width = 0.85,
               position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
      geom_text(data = inside_labels,
                aes(label = label, color = text_color),
                position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5, reverse = TRUE),
                size = 3, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
      geom_text(data = terminal_labels,
                aes(x = parameters, label = label),
                y = 101, hjust = 0,
                color = stack_colors[["terminal polyA"]],
                size = 3, fontface = "bold",
                inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
      annotate("text", x = callout_x, y = 12, label = "internal polyA",
               color = "#C4D8B6", fontface = "bold", size = 3.8) +
      annotate("text", x = callout_x, y = 70, label = "unexplained",
               color = "black", fontface = "bold", size = 3.8) +
      annotate("text", x = callout_x, y = 103, label = "terminal polyA",
               color = stack_colors[["terminal polyA"]], fontface = "bold",
               size = 3.8, hjust = 0.5) +
      annotate("segment", x = arrow_x_start, xend = arrow_x_end,
               y = 12, yend = 12, color = "#C4D8B6",
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm"), type = "closed")) +
      annotate("segment", x = arrow_x_start, xend = arrow_x_end,
               y = 70, yend = 70, color = "black",
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm"), type = "closed")) +
      annotate("segment", x = arrow_x_start, xend = arrow_x_end,
               y = 103, yend = 103, color = stack_colors[["terminal polyA"]],
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm"), type = "closed")) +
      scale_color_identity() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = stack_colors) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 110), expand = expansion(0),
                         breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100)) +
      scale_x_discrete(limits = rev, labels = cap_struck_labels(df_sorted)) +
      coord_flip(clip = "off") +
      labs(x = "Parameters", y = "Percentage of reads (%)", fill = NULL) +
      theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
      theme(legend.position = "none",
            plot.margin = margin(t = 45, r = 30, b = 10, l = 10))
  } else {
    p <- ggplot(long, aes(x = parameters, y = pct, fill = category)) +
      geom_col(alpha = 0.9, width = 0.85,
               position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = stack_colors) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = cap_struck_labels(df_sorted)) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100.01), expand = expansion(0)) +
      labs(x = "Parameters", y = "Percentage (%)", fill = NULL) +
      theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            legend.position = "right")
  }
  p
}
```

## Panel F: read-origin maps (Read1/Read2 histograms)

Prerequisites: `mac239.fa`, `d400_class_polya_structure_analysis.csv` from
`submissionScripts/Figure2/run_polya.sh`, and the D13 UMAP coordinate table
written by the Figure1 `### Seurat objects` chunk.

```{r}
fasta_path      <- paste0(genome.root, "Mmul_10_mac239/inputs/mac239.fa")
input_csv       <- paste0(data.root, "Figure2/polyA/bam_polya_virus/d400_class_polya_structure_analysis.csv")
seurat_umap_csv <- paste0(data.root, "Figure1/singleCell/Seurat/UMAPcoords/D13UMAP_coords.csv")
panel.dir       <- paste0(plot.root, "Figure2/")
dir.create(panel.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

reads <- read.csv(input_csv)
seurat_cellIDs <- read.csv(seurat_umap_csv)$cellID
reads <- reads %>%
  filter(!is.na(cb_corrected) & cb_corrected %in% seurat_cellIDs) %>%
  group_by(cb_corrected, ub_corrected) %>%
  filter(n() > 1) %>%
  ungroup()
cat(sprintf("Loaded %d reads after Seurat-cellID + UMI>1 filters\n", nrow(reads)))

find_arich_regions <- function(sequence, min_length, max_nonA) {
  bases <- strsplit(sequence, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  is_a  <- bases == "A"
  n     <- length(bases)
  starts_idx <- which(is_a)
  out <- vector("list", length(starts_idx))
  k <- 0L
  for (i in starts_idx) {
    mismatches <- 0L
    last_valid_end <- NA_integer_
    j <- i
    while (j <= n) {
      if (!is_a[j]) {
        mismatches <- mismatches + 1L
        if (mismatches > max_nonA) break
      }
      if (is_a[j] && (j - i + 1L) >= min_length) {
        last_valid_end <- j
      }
      j <- j + 1L
    }
    if (!is.na(last_valid_end)) {
      mm_count <- sum(!is_a[i:last_valid_end])
      k <- k + 1L
      out[[k]] <- c(i, last_valid_end, last_valid_end - i + 1L, mm_count)
    }
  }
  if (k == 0L) {
    return(data.frame(start_position = integer(), end_position = integer(),
                      length = integer(), mismatches = integer()))
  }
  m <- do.call(rbind, out[seq_len(k)])
  data.frame(start_position = as.integer(m[, 1]),
             end_position   = as.integer(m[, 2]),
             length         = as.integer(m[, 3]),
             mismatches     = as.integer(m[, 4]))
}

deduplicate_regions <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0L) return(df)
  df <- df[order(df$start_position, -df$end_position, df$mismatches), ]
  keep <- logical(nrow(df))
  max_end <- -1L
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
    if (df$end_position[k] <= max_end) next
    keep[k] <- TRUE
    max_end <- df$end_position[k]
  }
  df[keep, , drop = FALSE]
}

genome_len <- 9602L

# SIVmac239 LTR coordinates (mac239.fa).
ltr5_start <- 1L
ltr5_end   <- 540L
ltr3_start <- 9063L
ltr3_end   <- 9602L
pa_5ltr    <- 141L
pa_3ltr    <- 9602L

# Internal polyA parameters
overlay_A <- 8L
overlay_M <- 1L

mac239_seq <- toupper(paste0(readLines(fasta_path)[-1], collapse = ""))
internal_polyA_starts <- deduplicate_regions(
  find_arich_regions(mac239_seq, overlay_A, overlay_M)
)$start_position
# Drop sites that fall on the two terminal lines
internal_polyA_starts <- setdiff(internal_polyA_starts, c(pa_5ltr, pa_3ltr))
cat(sprintf("Internal polyA overlay (A=%d, M=%d): %d sites\n",
            overlay_A, overlay_M, length(internal_polyA_starts)))

make_position_map <- function(positions, title,
                              terminal_marks   = c(pa_5ltr, pa_3ltr),
                              terminal_labels  = c("5'LTR pA (141)",
                                                   "3'LTR pA (9602)"),
                              internal_marks   = internal_polyA_starts) {
  total_reads <- sum(as.integer(positions) >= 0L &
                     as.integer(positions) <= genome_len, na.rm = TRUE)
  pos_df <- data.frame(pos = as.integer(positions)) %>%
    filter(pos >= 0L & pos <= genome_len) %>%
    count(pos, name = "n") %>%
    mutate(frac = n / total_reads)

  y_max <- max(pos_df$frac, 1e-5)

  ggplot(pos_df, aes(x = pos, y = frac)) +
    # LTR rectangles drawn as a thin annotation strip just above the bars
    annotate("rect", xmin = ltr5_start, xmax = ltr5_end,
             ymin = y_max * 1.15, ymax = y_max * 1.35,
             fill = "#E6E6E6", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.25) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = ltr3_start, xmax = ltr3_end,
             ymin = y_max * 1.15, ymax = y_max * 1.35,
             fill = "#E6E6E6", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.25) +
    annotate("text", x = (ltr5_start + ltr5_end) / 2, y = y_max * 1.25,
             label = "5'LTR", size = 3, color = "gray30") +
    annotate("text", x = (ltr3_start + ltr3_end) / 2, y = y_max * 1.25,
             label = "3'LTR", size = 3, color = "gray30") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = internal_marks, color = "#C4D8B6",
               linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.25, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_col(width = 1, fill = "gray30", color = NA) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = terminal_marks, color = "#006838",
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.7) +
    annotate("text", x = terminal_marks, y = y_max * 1.6,
             label = terminal_labels, color = "#006838",
             size = 2.8, fontface = "bold", hjust = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 0.01),
                  expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, genome_len), expand = expansion(0)) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    labs(title = title, x = "mac239 position (bp)",
         y = "Fraction of reads (log)") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "italic",
                                     color = "gray40", size = 11),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 22, r = 6, b = 6, l = 6),
          panel.grid  = element_blank())
}

p_r1 <- make_position_map(reads$read1_end, "Read 1 (cellID-side)")
p_r2 <- make_position_map(reads$read2_pos, "Read 2 (cDNA-side, reference_start)")

position_map_plot <- p_r1 / p_r2
ggsave(paste0(panel.dir, "PanelF_read_alignment_position_maps.pdf"),
       position_map_plot, width = 12, height = 4.5)
print(position_map_plot)
```

```{r}
sample_name <- "Invitro"

  mutate(CaRe.count = CaRe) %>%
  mutate(CaRe = log1p(CaRe)) %>%

result[is.na(result)] <- 0

df <- apply_cd4t_gate(result, sample_name,
                      c("GEX", "GEX.US", "GEX.count",
                        "TenX.SS", "TenX.MS", "TenX.spliced",
                        "CaRe", "CaRe.count", "US", "MS", "SS"))

# `total` is the raw molecule count, not log1p(count)
exp1 <- df %>%
  filter(CaRe > 0) %>%
  select(US, SS, MS, spliced, CaRe.count) %>%
  rename(total = CaRe.count)
exp2 <- df %>%
  filter(GEX > 0) %>%
  select(GEX.US, GEX.count, TenX.SS, TenX.MS, TenX.spliced) %>%
  rename(US = GEX.US, total = GEX.count,
         SS = TenX.SS, MS = TenX.MS, spliced = TenX.spliced)

# HCR reference, one table per replicate
#
# A cell counts as infected when it carries at least one nef spot that
# colocalizes with an env spot (n_US + n_SS > 0). 
HCR.arm <- "batchthr"
HCR.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure2/bigFISH/")
HCR.paths <- if (HCR.arm == "batchthr") {
  c(rep1 = "manual_batchthr", rep2 = "manual_replicate2_batchthr")
} else {
  c(rep1 = "manual", rep2 = "manual_replicate2")
}

fish_list <- lapply(HCR.paths, function(d) {
  read.csv(file.path(HCR.dir, d, "all_cells_stats.csv")) %>%
    filter(n_US + n_SS > 0) %>%
    select(n_US, n_SS, n_MS, n_total_spots) %>%
    rename(US = n_US, SS = n_SS, MS = n_MS, total = n_total_spots) %>%
    mutate(spliced = SS + MS)
})
names(fish_list) <- names(HCR.paths)

for (rep_name in names(fish_list)) {
  cat(sprintf("HCR %s (%s): %d cells after n_US + n_SS > 0\n",
              rep_name, HCR.paths[[rep_name]], nrow(fish_list[[rep_name]])))
}

# Pool by cell
fish_list$combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(fish_list)
cat(sprintf("HCR combined: %d cells (%s)\n",
            nrow(fish_list$combined),
            paste(sprintf("%s %.0f%%", names(HCR.paths),
                          100 * sapply(names(HCR.paths),
                                       function(r) nrow(fish_list[[r]])) /
                            nrow(fish_list$combined)),
                  collapse = ", ")))

input_dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure2/longRead/bamsort/isoform/")
longread <- read.csv(paste0(input_dir, "cDNA_isoforms.csv"))
longread <- longread %>%
  count(cellID, isoform) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = isoform, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(spliced = MS + SS, total = US + MS + SS + any) %>%
  select(-cellID, -any)

# Long-read vs short-read viral read totals
invitro_longread_reads <- sum(longread$total, na.rm = TRUE)
invitro_care_reads    <- sum(care_data$total, na.rm = TRUE)
invitro_tenx_reads      <- sum(tenx_data$total, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("\n=== Invitro viral read totals (long-read vs short-read) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("  Long-read viral reads:  %d\n", invitro_longread_reads))
cat(sprintf("  Ca*Re viral reads:      %d (%.1fx more than long-read)\n",
            invitro_care_reads, invitro_care_reads / invitro_longread_reads))
cat(sprintf("  TenX viral reads:        %d (%.1fx more than long-read)\n",
            invitro_tenx_reads, invitro_tenx_reads / invitro_longread_reads))
cat(sprintf("  Ca*Re + TenX combined:   %d (%.1fx more than long-read)\n",
            invitro_care_reads + invitro_tenx_reads,
            (invitro_care_reads + invitro_tenx_reads) / invitro_longread_reads))

# Spliced-isoform fraction
spliced_cols <- c("SS", "MS", "SS.MS")
spliced_fraction <- function(df) {
  cols    <- intersect(spliced_cols, names(df))
  spliced <- if (length(cols)) sum(rowSums(df[cols], na.rm = TRUE)) else 0
  total   <- sum(df$total, na.rm = TRUE)
  c(spliced = spliced, total = total, fraction = spliced / total)
}
tenx_spliced   <- spliced_fraction(tenx_data)
care_spliced <- spliced_fraction(care_data)
cat("\n=== Spliced isoforms (SS + MS + SS|MS), normalized to total SIV ===\n")
cat(sprintf("  TenX:    %d spliced / %d total SIV = %.4f (%.3f%%)\n",
            tenx_spliced["spliced"], tenx_spliced["total"],
            tenx_spliced["fraction"], 100 * tenx_spliced["fraction"]))
cat(sprintf("  Ca*Re:  %d spliced / %d total SIV = %.4f (%.3f%%)\n",
            care_spliced["spliced"], care_spliced["total"],
            care_spliced["fraction"], 100 * care_spliced["fraction"]))
```


## Panel L: Q-Q plots vs HCR reference

Prerequisites: the `## Data loading` chunk above.

```{r QQ plot}
output.dir <- paste0(plot.root, "Figure2/")
dir.create(output.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

method_data <- list(
  "Ca*Re" = list(US = exp1$US, SS = exp1$SS, MS = exp1$MS,
                 spliced = exp1$spliced, total = exp1$total),
  GEX = list(US = exp2$US, SS = exp2$SS, MS = exp2$MS,
             spliced = exp2$spliced, total = exp2$total),
  longread = list(US = longread$US, SS = longread$SS, MS = longread$MS,
                  spliced = longread$spliced, total = longread$total)
)

for (rep_name in names(fish_list)) {
  fish <- fish_list[[rep_name]]
  ref_data <- list(US = fish$US, SS = fish$SS, MS = fish$MS,
                   spliced = fish$spliced, total = fish$total)

  plot_qq_grid(
    method_data = method_data,
    ref_data = ref_data,
    var_names = c("total", "spliced", "US", "SS", "MS"),
    method_names = c("Ca*Re", "TenX", "longread"),
    width = 20,
    output_file = paste0(output.dir, "PanelL_QQ_grid_", rep_name, ".pdf")
  )
}
```

## Panel M: Wasserstein distance to HCR reference

Prerequisites: the `## Data loading` chunk above.

```{r}
for (rep_name in names(fish_list)) {
  fish <- fish_list[[rep_name]]

  results_US <- compare_methods_to_reference(
    method_list = list(
      "Ca*Re" = exp1$US,
      GEX = exp2$US,
      longread = longread$US
    ),
    ref_vec = fish$US,
    var_name = "US"
  )

  results_spliced <- compare_methods_to_reference(
    method_list = list(
      "Ca*Re" = exp1$spliced,
      GEX = exp2$spliced,
      longread = longread$spliced
    ),
    ref_vec = fish$spliced,
    var_name = "spliced"
  )

  results_SS <- compare_methods_to_reference(
    method_list = list(
      "Ca*Re" = exp1$SS,
      GEX = exp2$SS,
      longread = longread$SS
    ),
    ref_vec = fish$SS,
    var_name = "SS"
  )

  results_MS <- compare_methods_to_reference(
    method_list = list(
      "Ca*Re" = exp1$MS,
      GEX = exp2$MS,
      longread = longread$MS
    ),
    ref_vec = fish$MS,
    var_name = "MS"
  )

  results_total <- compare_methods_to_reference(
    method_list = list(
      "Ca*Re" = exp1$total,
      GEX = exp2$total,
      longread = longread$total
    ),
    ref_vec = fish$total,
    var_name = "total"
  )

  results_list <- list(results_total, results_spliced, results_US,
                       results_SS, results_MS)

  plot_wasserstein_bars(
    results_list = results_list,
    var_names = c("total", "spliced", "US", "SS", "MS"),
    var_labels = c("total", "spliced", "unspliced",
                   "singly spliced", "multiply spliced"),
    method_names = c("Ca*Re", "TenX", "longread"),
    output_file = paste0(output.dir, "PanelM_wasserstein_bars_", rep_name, ".pdf")
  )
}
```
